description: Unit tests for google_breakpad::SynthMinidump classes, including sections, streams, memory, contexts, threads, exceptions, strings, lists, and dump headers.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Represents a section of data within a minidump, supporting appending data and referencing locations.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: Represents a data stream within a minidump, supporting appending data and referencing in sections.

classes.name: Memory
classes.description: Represents a memory region within a minidump, supporting appending data and referencing in sections.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Represents CPU context (registers) for different architectures within a minidump.

classes.name: Thread
classes.description: Represents a thread in the minidump, including its context, stack, and environment.

classes.name: Exception
classes.description: Represents an exception record within a minidump.

classes.name: String
classes.description: Represents a string object within the minidump, supporting encoding and referencing.

classes.name: List
classes.description: Template class for a list of minidump objects, supporting adding elements and serialization.

classes.name: Dump
classes.description: Represents the entire minidump file, including header, sections, and data.

methods.name: GetContents
methods.description: Serializes the object into a string of bytes.

methods.name: Finish
methods.description: Finalizes the object, preparing it for serialization.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends data or strings to the object.

methods.name: CiteLocationIn
methods.description: References this object in another container.

methods.name: CiteStreamIn
methods.description: References a stream in a section.

methods.name: Here
methods.description: Returns a label representing the current position.

methods.name: GetContents
methods.description: Retrieves the serialized bytes of the object.
